title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Sales agent as the agentic home for sellers
summary: Hold: the licensing field says entitlement is unpublished even though Microsoft documents the Sales agent licensing requirements. Two control paths start inside administrator settings without explaining how to reach them, and the CRM administrator role requirement omits the documented custom-role alternative. The roadmap dates and the cited preview limitations are supported.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; Open questions
claims.claim: The licensing model is unknown because nothing has been published for this new home itself.
claims.quote: To use Sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, you must meet one of the following licensing options: ... Dynamics 365 Sales Enterprise or Premium access, without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license | CRM data only
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to mixed. Retain the published basic/premium licence requirements and replace the blanket unpublished-entitlement wording with: 'Sales agent supports CRM-only use with Dynamics 365 Sales Enterprise or Premium access; Microsoft 365 Graph grounding requires Microsoft 365 Copilot. No licensing requirement specific to the new home is published.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-sales-copilot/set-up-sales-chat. Keep the narrower home-specific question, not an unknown product entitlement.
